messages.ussd.no_meter: No active meter on your account.
messages.ussd.enter_reading: Enter the black numbers on meter ...{serial} (m3):
messages.ussd.problem_menu:
What is the problem?
1 Leak at my meter or pipe
2 No water
3 Burst pipe on the street
messages.ussd.report_received: Report received{ref}. A technician will follow up. Thank you.
messages.ussd.pay: {hint} Amount in {currency}. You will get an SMS receipt.
messages.ussd.no_card: No water card on this number.
messages.reading.received: Thank you. Reading {value} m3 received (ref {ref}). Staff will check it before billing.
messages.pub.menu:
{org} water service
1 Report a leak or burst pipe
2 Report no water
3 Water status in my area
4 Apply for a water connection
9 Language
(To see your bill, register this phone at the water office.)
messages.pub.connection: Thank you. Connection request {ref} received. Our team will call you to arrange a site survey.
messages.pub.what:
What did you see?
1 Leak (dripping / small)
2 Burst pipe (lots of water)
messages.pub.report: Thank you. Report {ref} received. We will SMS you when it is fixed.
messages.lang.unknown: Send LANG followed by one of: {list}
messages.sms.unreg_report: Thank you. Report {ref} received{hint}. We will SMS you when it is fixed.
messages.sms.unreg_hint: — reply with the street or landmark to help our team find it
messages.sms.unregistered: This number is not registered with {org}. To report a leak send LEAK <place>. To see your bill, register this phone at the water office.
messages.sms.several: Several accounts use this number ({list}). Please use USSD {ussd} or visit the office.
messages.sms.read_help: Send READ followed by the black numbers on your meter, e.g. READ 1234.5
messages.sms.report: Report received{ref}. A technician will follow up.
messages.sms.plan_none: Your account has no arrears. Thank you!
messages.sms.plan_requested: Thank you. A cashier will contact you to agree an affordable payment plan for {amount}.
messages.sms.supply_off: Supply time messages switched OFF. Send SUPPLY ON to restart.
messages.sms.supply_none: No supply timetable is published for your area. Water is normally available all day.
messages.sms.no_card: No water card linked to this number.
messages.sms.help: {org} SMS: BAL, BILL, READ 1234 (meter reading), LEAK <where>, NOWATER, PAY, PLAN (payment plan), SUPPLY (next water time), CARD, LANG (language). Or dial {ussd}.
messages.notify.payment: Payment {amount} received, receipt {receipt}. Balance {balance}{credit}. Thank you.
messages.plan.agreed: Payment plan agreed for {account}: {down}{n} × {amount} ({freq}) from {start}. Pay by mobile money with ref {account}. Thank you.
messages.remind.due_soon: Friendly reminder — bill {bill} ({amount}) is due on {due}. Pay by mobile money with ref {account}. Check balance: {ussd}.
messages.remind.overdue: Bill {bill} ({amount}) is overdue. If you cannot pay in full, we can agree a payment plan — reply PLAN or visit the office. Ref {account}.
messages.remind.instalment: Payment plan instalment {seq}/{of} of {amount} is due {due}. Ref {account}. Thank you for keeping to your plan.
messages.report.ack: Thank you. Report {ref} received ({kind}). We will SMS you when it is resolved.
messages.report.resolved: Your report {ref} has been resolved. Thank you for helping us keep water flowing.
messages.report.closed: Your report {ref} was reviewed and closed. If the problem continues, please report again.
messages.report.cust_resolved: The problem you reported (ref A{id}) has been resolved. Thank you.
messages.report.cust_closed: The problem you reported (ref A{id}) has been reviewed and closed. Thank you.
messages.feedback.ask: How did we do? Reply 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent), you can add a comment.
messages.feedback.sorry: Thank you for telling us, and sorry we let you down. A manager will call you.
messages.conn.received: Connection application {ref} received. We will contact you to arrange a site survey. Track it at the water office or on our status page.
messages.conn.survey: Your connection {ref}: a site survey is scheduled{by}. Our technician will call before visiting.
messages.conn.rejected: Sorry — connection {ref} is not possible at this time: {reason}. You can still use the nearest public water point.
messages.conn.quote: Your connection {ref} quote: {amount}. You can pay a deposit and the rest in up to {n} monthly instalments on your water bill. Visit the office or reply to accept.
messages.conn.accepted: Thank you! Account {account} opened for connection {ref}.{deposit}{financed}
messages.conn.deposit: Please pay the deposit of {amount} by mobile money with ref {account}.
messages.conn.financed: The remaining {amount} will be added to your bills in {n} monthly instalments.
messages.conn.install: Connection {ref}: installation is booked{when}. Please make sure someone is at home.
messages.conn.live: Welcome! Connection {ref} is live. Account {account}, meter {meter}. Check your balance any time: {ussd}.
messages.share.bill: Your share of the compound water bill {bill} ({name}): {amount}, due {due}. Pay by mobile money with ref {ref}.
messages.supply.heads_up: Water comes on {when}{zone}. Fill your containers. Reply SUPPLY OFF to stop these messages.
messages.supply.cancelled: Sorry — water supply {when}{zone} is cancelled: {reason}. We will update you.
messages.quality.advisory: Water advisory for {point}: please boil or treat drinking water until further notice. We will SMS when it is safe.
messages.quality.lifted: Good news — water at {point} has passed re-testing. The advisory is lifted.
